title: Pseudosymmetry, Ricci soliton and Curvature Inheritance symmetries of Friedmann Lemaître Robertson Walker spacetime
summary: The Friedmann--Lemaître--Robertson--Walker (FLRW) spacetime, which was first proposed by Friedmann (1922--1924) and Lemaître (1927) and subsequently developed by Robertson and Walker (1935), is an isotropic and homogeneous cosmological model of the universe. This paper addresses a significant gap in the differential geometry literature by providing a comprehensive examination of the curvature properties of the FLRW spacetime.
